summary: Frontend-only verification of ActivityLog 'Detail Perubahan' expand rendering fix. Logged in as admin, navigated to /arc/activity-log, expanded rows including one with array value awb_ids. Confirmed labels render bold ABOVE values, values render inside bordered monospace <pre> boxes with whitespace-pre-wrap + break-words (no one-character-per-line wrapping), and toggle expand/collapse works without layout breakage. Object/array values are rendered readable (via JSON.stringify with 2-space indent when object). List still loads (200 rows in current date range).
context_for_next_testing_agent: ActivityLog Detail Perubahan layout fix verified. Screenshots at /app/.screenshots/activity_log_expanded.png and /app/.screenshots/activity_log_bulk_expanded.png show label-above-value bordered pre boxes rendering correctly. Array/object values wrap as words, not per character.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous break-all inside narrow 3-col grid caused character-level wrapping. Fix replaced break-all with break-words + whitespace-pre-wrap, moved labels above values, and made object/long values md:col-span-2. Verified visually.
